text:
sam (Eng Manager): Heads up: approved promo L2->L3. Want effective date retro to last month. What do I submit for backpay?

megan (People Ops): You'll need the leveling form + manager justification + exact effective date and salary numbers. If retro >30 days we need formal backpay approval.

riley (Compensation): Upload comp target and old/new annual salary. We'll calculate gross backpay. If >$3k or >15% bump finance review required.

sam (Eng Manager): Any template for justification?

megan (People Ops): Short bullets: scope change, impact, calibration note. 3 lines works.

toni (Payroll): For processing include employee ID via secure form, paycode PROMO_BP, lump_sum vs spread, and tax instruction. We can't accept PII here.

payroll-bot: Reminder: use https://redwood/payroll/secure for IDs and https://redwood/leveling/upload for docs. No SSNs in-channel.

sam (Eng Manager): Uploaded docs to portal and marked backpay=yes.

riley (Compensation): Got it. I'll run numbers and post estimate. Expect comp triage in 2 business days.

megan (People Ops): If finance sign-off required we'll route after comp approves. Escalation: if no response in 5 business days, ping People Ops director.

sam (Eng Manager): Thanks — appreciate the timeline.
